text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Hup, there we go.
Will this be all right?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! You've really saved me!
And to come all the way from the gym, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Um, please, by all means! Let me do something to thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need at all.
Please let me know whenever you need a hand again.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (Sh-She treats it like second nature... How amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (...I-I want to... become like that too—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
While walking outside for a change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"How about a classic spunky, energetic student? Ah!
Or maybe an elite special investigator kind of setup!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, sorry! Those are all lovely ideas, but they might not give me that sudden spark for the protagonist...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening in, it seemed they were working on a new manga.
However, they appeared to be struggling to brainstorm ideas for the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so sorry! You've been helping me out ever since last night...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I'll think up the rest on my own after all! I'd feel bad making trouble for you!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"No, please don't worry about it!
Um... Maru-chan knows, you see."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"That you've been drawing manga until late at night.
Light has been leaking out from under your blanket!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Seeing that made me want to do something to help—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"So at the very least, let me do this much!
I want to lend a hand to Kiseki-san when you're working so hard!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What a... what a wonderful girl you are!
To think you care that much about me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Aha! I've got it!
The protagonist... is you, Marche-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "—Huh!? Me!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, yes!!
This manga is gonna be fantastic!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's brimming with kindness and hope...
Phew~~~~ It's all thanks to you, Marche-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Oh no, not at all!
It's your incredible imagination, Kiseki-san!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aw, Marche-chaaaan!!
Hey, let me thank you! Let me repay you for helping!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"No need. I don't need any thanks!
Instead—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "If something comes up again, please let me help out, okay? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Marche-chan!
.........And she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She went out of her way to help me!
I'm gonna polish this into something even better—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer-san. Kiseki-san sent me a manga she drew.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Reading it just naturally brought a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... the kind-hearted protagonist connects all kinds of different people.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And that warm circle keeps spreading wider and wider to others... It's such a lovely story!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so!
If you'd like, Trainer-san, would you care to read it with me?
